01-01.text: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

01-02.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

01-03.text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

01-04.text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

01-05.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

01-06.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

01-07.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

01-08.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

01-09.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

01-10.text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

01-11.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

01-12.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

01-13.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

01-14.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

01-15.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

01-16.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

01-17.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

01-18.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

01-19.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

01-20.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

01-21.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

01-22.text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

01-23.text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

01-24.text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

01-25.text: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

01-26.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

01-27.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

01-28.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

01-29.text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

01-30.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

01-31.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

02-01.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

02-02.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

02-03.text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

02-04.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

02-05.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

02-06.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

02-07.text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

02-08.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

02-09.text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

02-10.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

02-11.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

02-12.text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

02-13.text: We love him, because he first loved us.

02-14.text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

02-15.text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

02-16.text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

02-17.text: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

02-18.text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

02-19.text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

02-20.text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

02-21.text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

02-22.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

02-23.text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

02-24.text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

02-25.text: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

02-26.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

02-27.text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

02-28.text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

02-29.text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

03-01.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

03-02.text: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

03-03.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

03-04.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

03-05.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

03-06.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

03-07.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

03-08.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

03-09.text: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

03-10.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

03-11.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

03-12.text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation. He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

03-13.text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

03-14.text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

03-15.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

03-16.text: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

03-17.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

03-18.text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

03-19.text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

03-20.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

03-21.text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

03-22.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

03-23.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

03-24.text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

03-25.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

03-26.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

03-27.text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

03-28.text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

03-29.text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

03-30.text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

03-31.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

04-01.text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

04-02.text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

04-03.text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

04-04.text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

04-05.text: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

04-06.text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

04-07.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

04-08.text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

04-09.text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

04-10.text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

04-11.text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

04-12.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

04-13.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

04-14.text: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

04-15.text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

04-16.text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

04-17.text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths. Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

04-18.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

04-19.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

04-20.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

04-21.text: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

04-22.text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

04-23.text: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

04-24.text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

04-25.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

04-26.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

04-27.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

04-28.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

04-29.text: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

04-30.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

05-01.text: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

05-02.text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

05-03.text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

05-04.text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

05-05.text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

05-06.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

05-07.text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

05-08.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

05-09.text: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

05-10.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

05-11.text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

05-12.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

05-13.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

05-14.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

05-15.text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

05-16.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

05-17.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

05-18.text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

05-19.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

05-20.text: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

05-21.text: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

05-22.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

05-23.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

05-24.text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

05-25.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

05-26.text: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

05-27.text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

05-28.text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

05-29.text: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

05-30.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

05-31.text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

06-01.text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

06-02.text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

06-03.text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

06-04.text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

06-05.text: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

06-06.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

06-07.text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

06-08.text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

06-09.text: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

06-10.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

06-11.text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

06-12.text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

06-13.text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

06-14.text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

06-15.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

06-16.text: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

06-17.text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

06-18.text: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

06-19.text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

06-20.text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

06-21.text: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

06-22.text: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

06-23.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

06-24.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

06-25.text: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

06-26.text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

06-27.text: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

06-28.text: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

06-29.text: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

06-30.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

07-01.text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

07-02.text: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

07-03.text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

07-04.text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

07-05.text: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

07-06.text: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.

07-07.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

07-08.text: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

07-09.text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our LORD: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

07-10.text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

07-11.text: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

07-12.text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

07-13.text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

07-14.text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

07-15.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

07-16.text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

07-17.text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

07-18.text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

07-19.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

07-20.text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

07-21.text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

07-22.text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

07-23.text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

07-24.text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

07-25.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

07-26.text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

07-27.text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

07-28.text: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

07-29.text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

07-30.text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

07-31.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

08-01.text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

08-02.text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

08-03.text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

08-04.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

08-05.text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

08-06.text: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

08-07.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

08-08.text: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

08-09.text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

08-10.text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

08-11.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

08-12.text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

08-13.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

08-14.text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

08-15.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

08-16.text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

08-17.text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

08-18.text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

08-19.text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

08-21.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

08-22.text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

08-23.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

08-24.text: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

08-25.text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

08-26.text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

08-27.text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

08-28.text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

08-29.text: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

08-30.text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

08-31.text: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

09-01.text: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

09-02.text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

09-03.text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

09-04.text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

09-05.text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

09-06.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

09-07.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

09-08.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

09-09.text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

09-10.text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

09-11.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

09-12.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

09-13.text: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

09-14.text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

09-15.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

09-16.text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

09-17.text: Let all your things be done with charity.

09-18.text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

09-19.text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

09-20.text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

09-21.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

09-22.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

09-23.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

09-24.text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

09-25.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

09-26.text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

09-27.text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

09-28.text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

09-29.text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

09-30.text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

10-01.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

10-02.text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

10-03.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

10-04.text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

10-05.text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

10-06.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

10-07.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

10-08.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

10-09.text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

10-10.text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

10-11.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

10-12.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

10-13.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

10-14.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

10-15.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

10-16.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

10-17.text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

10-18.text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

10-19.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

10-20.text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

10-21.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

10-22.text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

10-23.text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

10-24.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

10-25.text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

10-26.text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

10-27.text: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

10-28.text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

10-29.text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

10-30.text: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

10-31.text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

11-01.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

11-02.text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

11-03.text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

11-04.text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

11-05.text: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

11-06.text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

11-07.text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

11-08.text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

11-09.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

11-10.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

11-11.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

11-12.text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

11-13.text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

11-14.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

11-15.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

11-16.text: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

11-17.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

11-18.text: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

11-19.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

11-20.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

11-21.text: IT IS A GOOD THING TO GIVE THANKS UNTO THE LORD, AND TO SING PRAISES UNTO THY NAME, O MOST HIGH:

11-22.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

11-23.text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

11-24.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

11-25.text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

11-26.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

11-27.text: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

11-28.text: O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people. For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

11-29.text: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

11-30.text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

12-01.text: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

12-02.text: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

12-03.text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

12-04.text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

12-05.text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

12-06.text: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.

12-07.text: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

12-08.text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us, To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

12-09.text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

12-10.text: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

12-11.text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

12-12.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

12-13.text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

12-14.text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

12-15.text: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

12-16.text: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God. And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

12-17.text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

12-18.text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

12-19.text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

12-20.text: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

12-21.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

12-22.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

12-23.text: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

12-24.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

12-25.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

12-26.text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

12-27.text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

12-28.text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

12-29.text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

12-30.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

12-31.text: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
